फुलेरा के दिन फिरने वाले हैं क्योंकि अब प्रधानी की कुर्सी पर असली विलेन बैठ गया है! 😱

Amazon Prime Video की चहेती सीरीज Panchayat Season 5 का मजेदार trailer आउट हो चुका है और इस बार फुलेरा में गजब का ड्रामा होने वाला है। पिछले सीजन के अंत में भूषण उर्फ बनराकस ने चुनाव जीतकर प्रधानी छीन ली थी, जिससे पुराने प्रधान जी अब महज एक आम नागरिक रह गए हैं। trailer में दिखाया गया है कि बनराकस अब ऑफिस में काम कर रहे सचिव जी और चंदन को परेशान करने और टॉर्चर करने का कोई मौका नहीं छोड़ रहा है।

मुसीबत तब और बढ़ जाती है जब बनराकस को सचिव जी और रिंकी के गुप्त रोमांस का पता चल जाता है, जबकि सचिव जी MBA इंटरव्यू की तैयारी में जुटे हैं। वेल-विशर्स की सलाह पर सचिव जी इस्तीफा देने की सोच रहे हैं, लेकिन इसी बीच वह रिंकी का हाथ मांगने का फैसला करते हैं। Deepak Kumar Mishra के निर्देशन में बनी यह सीरीज 3 December को आएगी जिसमें Jitendra Kumar और Neena Gupta जैसे पुराने सितारे धमाका करेंगे। ✨

क्या आपको लगता है कि सचिव जी बनराकस के राज में फुलेरा छोड़कर चले जाएंगे या डटकर मुकाबला करेंगे? 👇

ctx.summary:
The trailer of Panchayat 5 gives us a glimpse of what Phulera looks like under the reign of Banrakas.  
 The post  Panchayat Season 5 Trailer Review: Banrakas’ Reign Comes With New Drama, Troubles And Humor!  appeared first on  Koimoi .
ctx.text:
A new day has dawned in Phulera village. After an intense battle, Season 4 culminated with Bhushan, aka Banrakas, winning the panchayat elections and becoming the village head. After years, the position and power of the village head have been taken away from the OG Pradhan Ji. He is no longer the Pradhan of the village and is just a regular citizen. The previous season ended on this shocking note, at least for Pradhan Ji and his admirers, including Abhishek Tripathi, aka Sachiv Ji. The trailer for the new season of the beloved TVF show on Amazon Prime Video has been released. The trailer gives us a glimpse of what to expect from the new regime under Banrakas. It opens with one of the most hilarious situations. For years, Brij Bhushan was addressed as Pradhan Ji. The trailer opens with Chandan, Sachiv Ji, Prahlad, and Pradhan Ji having a conversation. When Chandan addresses him as Pradhan Ji, he says that he no longer holds that title. However, Chandan tells him that, for him, he will always be Pradhan Ji. At this point, Sachiv Ji gets a call from Banrakas. He addresses him as Pradhan Ji, and there is a moment of silence, which makes for a really good moment. Panchayat Season 5 Trailer The Panchayat Season 5 trailer further gives us a glimpse of what the regime looks like under Banrakas’ reign. He leaves no stone unturned to torture Sachiv Ji and Chandan, who are still working in the panchayat office. Banrakas tries to make their lives as difficult as possible. During this time, Sachiv Ji is told by his well-wishers that he must resign and leave rather than continue working for Banrakas. Sachiv Ji considers it. But Rinki is in town. The two have been having their secret romance away from the villagers. Meanwhile, Sachiv Ji is also preparing for his MBA interviews. To add to his problems, Banrakas learns about his romance with Rinki. It becomes the new problem in town. But Sachiv Ji decides to ask for Rinki’s hand in marriage. What happens under Banrakas’ reign and what happens to Sachiv Ji form the rest of the story. Eetha Trailer Review: Shraddha Kapoor Is No Bechari In A Nauvari – Dances To Aasmaan Ka Mandap, Chaand Ki Light, Hawaaon Ka Speaker! Panchayat is now coming up with its fifth season. Most series become tiring at this point. However, that is not the case with the TVF series. The series is still very refreshing and features new, interesting conflicts despite the limited number of people and characters in the village. The problems do not seem repetitive, and the characters keep everything fresh and lovely. The energy is still the same as it was in the first season. For fans who have been following the show since Season 1, the characters of Panchayat seem like family, and it just feels natural to see their journey progress. Made under the direction of Deepak Kumar Mishra, Panchayat Season 5 has been created by Deepak Kumar Mishra, Chandan Kumar, and Arunabh Kumar, and written by Chandan Kumar. It will see the ensemble cast reprising their roles from the show. Jitendra Kumar, Raghubir Yadav, Neena Gupta, Sunita Rajwar, Faizal Malik, Chandan Roy, Sanvikaa, Durgesh Kumar, and Ashok Pathak will return in their popular avatars in the latest season. Panchayat Season 5 is expected to premiere on Prime Video on December 3. Watch trailer here: Stay tuned to Koimoi for more trailer and teaser reviews!
